title: How inbound integration webhooks prove who sent them
question: What must Procore, Autodesk, Fieldwire, Togal and internal pipeline callbacks present before Track3D acts on them (signature, shared secret, IP allow list), and what is logged from them?
context: The Fieldwire handler acts on the posted data directly (INTG-REQ-016), and the Togal handler logs full headers.
